entities.summary: Archbishop Emmanuel Dabbaghian, I.C.P.B. was a Syrian-born Armenian Catholic hierarch. He served as an archbishop of Armenian Catholic Archeparchy of Baghdad from 26 January 2007 until his retirement on 9 October 2017.
